content.what_it_is: CUDA Fortran wave-breaking module (`wave_breaking_module`, L16-L309). The host routine `WAVE_BREAKING_GPU` configures a two-dimensional launch and either advances breaking age plus artificial eddy viscosity with `breaking_kernel` (L30-L41) or applies wavemaker-only viscosity with `viscosity_wmaker_kernel` (L42-L48). The wavemaker kernel derives a shallow-water speed scale, applies Cartesian or cellwise spacing, tests a rectangular wavemaker footprint, and writes depth-scaled viscosity when the surface time derivative exceeds a capped threshold (L75-L114). The breaking kernel stages prior breaking age in shared memory, starts or propagates breaking according to local time derivative, surface-gradient direction and neighbor ages, then applies one of four compile-time viscosity formulas inside or outside the wavemaker (L143-L307).

unresolved: Use-before-assignment across branches: breaking_kernel assigns DXg and DYg only inside the Age_sh<=ZERO, non-immediate-trigger branch at L168-L184, but all paths then use them to compute xmk/ymk at L234-L238. If the immediate trigger branch L162-L164 or positive-age branch L166-L167 is taken, wavemaker footprint selection consumes undefined DXg/DYg.

Shared-memory boundary initialization gap: Age_sh is initialized only for global indices inside Ibeg-1:Iend+1 and Jbeg-1:Jend+1 at L151-L153, while the subsequent computation also admits central cells on those same inclusive edges at L156-L157 and reads tx±1/ty±1 neighbors at L196-L222. For an admitted central cell on an expanded-domain edge, the corresponding outward neighbor slot was not initialized by L151-L153; thread-index interior checks prevent shared-array index overflow but do not ensure that neighbor slot received a value.

Current-age/viscosity lag requires caller-level confirmation: the kernel writes newly started or propagated ages to AGE_BREAKING_d at L162-L225, but exterior viscosity tests the prior snapshot Age_sh at L257 rather than the new AGE_BREAKING_d value. A cell whose prior age is zero can be marked with AGE_BREAKING_d=DT yet receive zero exterior viscosity at L300-L301 until a later invocation.

Angular partition does not include an exact +180 degree result: ATAN2 is converted to degrees at L190, quadrant 2 is [90,180) at L203, and quadrant 3 begins at -180 at L211. Whether ATAN2 can yield +180 for signed-zero inputs, leaving propagation unhandled, is not resolved in this file.

viscosity_wmaker_kernel receives and declares WAVEMAKER_Cbrk at L45-L48 and L62-L69 but never references it in its body; Iend and Jend are likewise passed but its bounds use Mloc/Nloc at L80. Whether these are stale interface arguments or intentionally retained ABI symmetry is not stated.
Local cap2 (L135), AGE1/AGE2/AGE3 (L139), and imported MGlob/NGlob and several selected GLOBAL symbols (L19-L22) are not used in this module; no intent is documented here.
